title: Alduin's Wall
description: After rescuing Esbern from the Thalmor in Riften's Ratway, escort him to Riverwood to reunite with Delphine. The Blades then travel to Sky Haven Temple to find Alduin's Wall, which may reveal how to defeat Alduin.

base_facts: I am the Blades loremaster, hiding from the Thalmor in the Ratway beneath Riften.
I have studied dragons and ancient Blades records for decades.
Alduin's Wall at Sky Haven Temple may hold the secret to defeating Alduin.

ESCORT_ESBERN_RIVERWOOD: I have escaped the Ratway and am traveling with the Dragonborn to meet Delphine in Riverwood.
TALK_TO_ESBERN: I have reunited with Delphine. We must find Sky Haven Temple and Alduin's Wall.
GAIN_ENTRANCE_SKY_HAVEN: The blood seal has been opened by the Dragonborn's blood. Sky Haven Temple is ours again.
LEARN_SECRET_WALL: Alduin's Wall reveals that the ancient Nords used a Shout to defeat Alduin. The Greybeards may know it.

base_facts: I am a Blade, operating in secret at the Sleeping Giant Inn in Riverwood.
I sent the Dragonborn to find Esbern in Riften.

TALK_TO_ESBERN: Esbern is alive. He speaks of Sky Haven Temple and Alduin's Wall. The Karthspire matches the location he described.
GAIN_ENTRANCE_SKY_HAVEN: Sky Haven Temple is real. The Blades have a home again.
LEARN_SECRET_WALL: The Greybeards may know the Shout that can defeat Alduin, though I distrust them.

beats.comment: Player escorts Esbern from the Ratway to the Sleeping Giant Inn in Riverwood.
Esbern and Delphine reunite at the Sleeping Giant Inn and discuss finding Sky Haven Temple.
Player solves the Akaviri puzzles and opens the blood seal at Sky Haven Temple.
Esbern reads Alduin's Wall and reveals the ancient Nords used a Shout to defeat Alduin.
Quest complete. Alduin's Wall revealed the ancient Shout. Next destination: High Hrothgar.
